arjun: Quick heads-up — ran a full nsight capture on the 16-GPU tensor/pipeline run for seq_len=1024, batch=8. Saw a repeating mid-step stall right after pipeline stage 2 finishes; all ranks except rank3 hit kernel launches, but rank3 delays ~3.8-5ms causing subsequent all-reduce tail. Nsight shows idle gaps aligned with NCCL allreduce kickoff. :thinking:

arjun: custom timers snapshot:
```
[rank 0] step 1462: kernel_launch_us: 118
[rank 0] step 1462: allreduce_start_us: 242
[rank 0] step 1462: allreduce_end_us: 410
...
[rank 3] step 1462: kernel_launch_us: 122
[rank 3] step 1462: allreduce_start_us: 4210   <-- outlier
[rank 3] step 1462: allreduce_end_us: 4386
```

maria: can you run per-rank nsight traces? set RUNTIME_KERNEL_TRACE=1 and do nsys per-rank so we can see kernel selection on rank3. try:
```
nsys profile -o nsys_run_rank${RANK} --trace=cuda,nvtx python -m bench.run --rank=$RANK --seq_len=1024
```

kevin: also try toggling NCCL algorithm to tree to shrink tail, e.g.:
```
export NCCL_ALGO=tree
export NCCL_COLLNET=0
```
and compare with ring. try KVCACHE_PREFETCH=1 PREFETCH_BATCHES=2 to see if warmup evicts something.

sophia: is this only with kv-cache warmup? compare cold-run (no prefetch) vs warm-run. I also suspect a per-rank page-fault when kv_cache_shard=global. try kv_cache_shard=per_gpu.

chip: another angle: force kernel selector override for the attention op near the pipeline boundary. If the rank chooses a slower large-batch kernel it can delay others. Example override:
```
export KERNEL_SELECTOR_OVERRIDES='attn_block_23:smallb'
```
If that fixes it, we'll add a fallback in the selector for cross-rank skew.

arjun: action items: (1) run nsys per-rank with RUNTIME_KERNEL_TRACE=1 (2) microbench vary seq_len/batch to isolate (3) toggle NCCL_ALGO tree/ring (4) try kv_cache_shard/per_gpu and KVCACHE_PREFETCH=1 (5) post nsight snapshot here. I'll start runs tonight and upload traces. :rocket:

deploy-bot: scheduled job 1991112222-nsys-trace started at 1991112300

kevin: I'll add short timers around kernel_enqueue and allreduce calls in runtime and open a PR so we get per-op jitter in logs.

arjun: great — thanks all, will report back with traces and heatmaps by tomorrow morning. :eyes:
